title: Concept: WildFly or JBoss error report disclosed in a response
description: The Undertow error report served by WildFly and JBoss prints the exception class, the deployment name and the server build. That combination identifies the exact application server and often the deployed artefact, which is the information a reader needs to choose a matching issue.
applicability: Responses served by WildFly, JBoss EAP or a standalone Undertow deployment.
risk: Exception detail and the application server identity reach the client; MEDIUM severity because it is diagnostic output.
